小心！ 老虎来了！ (Chinese (Simplified)) 当老虎穿过森林时，每只动物都会知道！ 听取警告大家老虎已经到了个样的警报声。 This is a Level 1 book for children who are eager to begin reading. Pratham Books goes digital to weave a whole new chapter in the realm of multilingual children's stories. Knitting together children, authors, illustrators and publishers. Folding in teachers, and translators. To create a rich fabric of openly licensed multilingual stories for the children of India and the world. Our unique online platform, StoryWeaver, is a playground where children, parents, teachers and librarians can get creative. Come, start weaving today, and help us get a book in every child's hand!

pages.originalText:
做老虎不容易。

是的，老虎很美，也很凶。
pages.text:
做老虎不容易。
是的，老虎很美，也很凶。

image.attributionText: Page 2: Tiger looking at its reflection , by Rohan Chakravarty © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText:
但是老虎也又大又重。

因为这样，他们寻找食物很困难。
pages.text:
不过，老虎的身体又大又重。
想悄悄靠近猎物，可不容易。

image.attributionText: Page 3: Tiger Looking at Hare , by Rohan Chakravarty © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText: 老虎每20次捕猎，只能吃一次。
pages.text:
老虎有时要捕猎很多次，
才会成功一次。

image.attributionText: Page 4: Tiger with Dead Deer , by Rohan Chakravarty © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText:
老虎穿过森林时，

轰！ 啪！ 砰！

猴子的叫声，就像一个老人在咳嗽！

轰！ 啪！ 砰！

pages.originalText:
嚎! 嚎!

吠叫鹿的叫声，像一只害怕的狗！

嚎! 嚎!
pages.text:
嚎！嚎！
吠鹿的叫声，像一只害怕的狗！
嚎！嚎！

image.attributionText: Page 6: Barking Deer Sounding An Alarm Call , by Rohan Chakravarty © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText:
喔！ 喔！ 喔！

斑点鹿的叫声，像一只小鸟！

喔！ 喔！ 喔！
pages.text:
喔！ 喔！ 喔！
斑点鹿的叫声，像一只小鸟！
喔！ 喔！ 喔！

image.attributionText: Page 7: Spotted Deer Sounding an Alarm Call , by Rohan Chakravarty © Pratham Books, 2017. Some rights reserved. Released under CC BY 4.0 license.

pages.originalText:
整片森林都知道老虎已经来了！

吼? 吼?

老虎想知道，大家都去了哪里？

editorialReview.scope: 全文文字与页面结构；插画实际质量由root另行看图，不以封面或绘者名字代替验图；originalText按.content段落保留源结构，editedText整理空段和断词，不删除正文分数
editorialReview.visualReview: 已逐本检查原版全页插画联系图：画风连贯、图文对应、无不适合5岁目标的强惊吓近景；原JPG保持不变，仅显示裁掉外围空白。

dimensions.literacy: 短句、重复拟声词，老虎/猴子/小鹿/森林形成具体认读场景；可边看图边模仿警报声。
dimensions.story: 从“做老虎不容易”反转出发，到整片森林都知道它来了，结尾找不到猎物有幽默，低阶也有鲜明观察角度。
dimensions.visualProxy: Rohan Chakravarty动物漫画风格需root逐图确认；图中动物的表情和隐蔽位置应构成阅读趣味。

warnings: 将无年份、无条件的“每20次才成功一次”改为一般描述，不教孩子背固定捕猎成功率。
